app.name: ANVYRA
app.tagline: Tracking the growth of our village
app.description: A simple way to follow village building work. Supervisors send a daily update in their own words, and the Village Officer checks it.

features.ai: AI understands updates in English, Hindi and Telugu
features.all: Progress, materials and budget in one place

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Welcome back. Please enter your details.
login.demoHint: Tap a button to fill in the demo login.
login.needBoth: Please enter your email and password.
login.failed: Could not sign in. Please try again.

dash.chartProgressHint: Solid line: work done. Dashed line: plan.
dash.chartBudgetHint: If the ochre bar is much taller than the green one, spending is ahead of the work.

home.noUpdates: You have not sent any update yet.

send.title: Send today's update
send.question: What work was done today?
send.placeholder: Example: Completed 2 columns, used 40 bags cement

send.checkNote: We are not sure about some parts. The officer will check them.
send.sent: Update sent. The officer will check it.
send.empty: Please write what work was done.

review.title: Review Updates
review.subtitle: Check what the AI understood, then approve, change or reject.
review.emptyWaiting: All caught up. No updates are waiting.
